title: Smoke detectors in smoke or fire/smoke damper installations: connection to the fire alarm system
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: October 2024 (platform created October 16, 2024, last updated October 16, 2024)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies whether NBC(AE) requires a smoke detector used in a smoke or fire/smoke damper operation to be connected to the fire alarm system.
Sentence 3.1.8.11.(3) requires smoke dampers and combination smoke/fire dampers to close automatically upon a signal from an adjacent smoke detector.
The document states that this damper provision does not require adhering to any additional fire alarm system requirements.
